content: this is a summary of a legal case that took place in the vilnius regional district court the case involved a couple going through a divorce and addressing the division of their matrimonial property the court decided to award the audi a3 vehicle to the applicant as their personal property without requiring any compensation from the defendant the applicant also requested maintenance for their minor child and to be declared as the trustee of the childs funds the court received a report supporting the applicants claims and considered the financial situation of both parties in determining the amount of maintenance to be paid the defendant failed to file a statement of defense or attend the hearing the court ordered the applicant to pay the defendant for stamp duty and legal costs while the defendant was charged for the child maintenance claim and the costs of serving procedural documents the courts decision was to dissolve the marriage and award the audi a3 vehicle to the applicant

metadata.cost: - € 62,00 (stamp duty) + € 713,00 (professional fees) + € 5,53 (court fees) to be borne by the defendant
